description: This file defines multiple serialization interfaces for the TestLink project, including interfaces for general serialization, database serialization, CSV, XML, and database object serialization.

methods.name: getSupportedSerializationInterfaces
methods.description: Returns all supported Import/Export Serialization Interfaces in a human readable way

methods.name: getSupportedSerializationFormatDescriptions
methods.description: Returns all supported Import/Export Serialization Interfaces Format Descriptor

methods.name: readFromDBRow
methods.description: Initializes the object from a single result row of a query

methods.name: getReadFromDBQuery
methods.description: Returns a query which can be used to read an arbitrary number of objects

methods.name: getFormatDescriptionForCSV
methods.description: Returns the format description for CSV

methods.name: writeToXML
methods.description: Serializes the objects to XML code

methods.name: readFromXML
methods.description: Serializes the objects from XML code

methods.name: readFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Serializes the objects from a SimpleXML node

methods.name: getFormatDescriptionForXML
methods.description: Returns the format description for XML

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Serializes the object to the database connection

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Serializes the object from the database connection

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the object from the database connection

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Factory function to create an object from database

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Factory function to create multiple objects from database

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Factory function to retrieve all objects from database with optional filtering
